title: Tree falls across the top of Belfield Road
excerpt: A large tree has come down at the top of Belfield Road in Rochdale, with its trunk and branches lying across the carriageway and pavement.
body:
A large tree has fallen at the top of Belfield Road in Rochdale.

A photograph sent to Rochdale Daily shows the trunk lying across the carriageway, with branches reaching to the front of a terraced house on the opposite side of the road. Debris covers the pavement, and part of a metal railing appears to have been knocked over.

It is not yet known when the tree came down or what caused it. There have been no reports of anyone being hurt.

With the trunk lying across the road, drivers and pedestrians are advised to avoid the area and use another route until the tree has been cleared.

A fallen tree blocking a public road can be reported to Rochdale Borough Council's highways team. If it has brought down power lines or poses an immediate danger, call 999 and keep well away.

Rochdale Daily will update this story when we know more about clearance and whether the road has reopened.

Were you affected, or did you see the tree come down? Tell us in the comments or email news@rochdaledaily.co.uk.
